actual: The formal P2-4 request CLI accepts a db_env_prefix without binding the resulting host/port/dbname to the frozen candidate database_identity. _resolve_outcome_tail_end discards the connection identity and _prepare_request sets holdout_accessed=true before _load_l1_source_inputs has read any holdout feature or outcome. A wrong but reachable database therefore fails on missing PIT universe state and persists status=NOT_AVAILABLE with holdout_accessed=true, falsely consuming the one-logical-holdout contract. Fix must validate the exact candidate-authoritative database identity and required PIT source metadata before any holdout business read, preserve holdout_accessed=false for such preflight failures, retain typed evidence, and must not add retries, change model thresholds, reselect the candidate, or weaken fail-closed behavior.
